intro_q: Your group is working on a shared coursework presentation due next week. One member, Jordan, has now missed two consecutive meetings without any notice, leaving tasks unfinished. Write an email to your group leader, Sam.
bullet1_q: State how many meetings Jordan has missed and what work remains incomplete.
bullet2_q: Explain how the absences are affecting the rest of the group's progress.
bullet3_q: Suggest a course of action the group could take going forward.
